mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the purchase book was worthwhile: the receipts turned the misleading ownership sticker into a concrete distinction between the leased modem and cooperative equipment.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence became somewhat repetitive once each decision offered only one combination, even though the tactile labels had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The modem could retain its uplink while its separate approval signal was removed from door control.

arbitrary.text: Pairing the fobs with the selector initially felt a little opaque; the result clarified that recognition authorizes access but does not move the switch.

continue.text: Yes. The shared-control outcome was satisfying, and I would be curious to see how the neighborhood extends it beyond the rack, though the single-option sequence was less engaging.
